name: parallel-design-exploration
title: Parallel Design Exploration
description: Standalone Open Design scenario for persistent parallel exploration: render sibling design options together, preserve prior turns visibly, maintain stable option identities, and converge only when the user chooses to.

query.en: Use Parallel Design Exploration for my brief. Create one persistent exploration document with {{variantCount}} materially different sibling options per turn. Show siblings together, give every option a stable id, place the newest turn above older turns, preserve earlier turns visibly, explain each option's design hypothesis and tradeoffs, and let me decide when to converge.
query.zh-CN: 使用 Parallel Design Exploration 处理我的设计需求。创建一个持续存在的设计探索文档，每轮生成 {{variantCount}} 个实质不同的并行方案并同时展示；为每个方案保留稳定 ID；最新一轮位于旧轮次上方；旧轮次持续可见；说明每个方案的设计假设、关键变化与取舍；由我决定何时收敛。
